Name: Yri's Modular Water Recolor - Alpha
Author: YriKururu
Description:
[center]Yri's Modular Water Recolor
Standalone/Vanilla Version

- For the Project Yellog Town Overhaul Version [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9799]click here[/url] -﻿

With this mod you can change the color and wavetype of the water over 3 seasons.

*****

[b]THIS IS AN ALPHA MOD - YOU WILL PROBABLY ENCOUNTER BUGS! [/b]
Please bear in mind that the colors scheme will slightly change from season to season even if you use the same options!
Ginger Island is currently bugged and might display the water for the current season and not the summer water (I'm on it)
Right now this mod does [b]NOT [/b]work with DaisyNikos Tilesheets! I still work on it.   

*****

Installation:
1. Download the file 
2. Unpack them
3. Drag them into your mods folder
4. Select your options
5. Enjoy!
﻿
*****

***This is an Alpha Version so there is a possibility﻿ that you may encounter bugs, if you find something please inform me so i can patch them asap ***﻿[/center]
